description: This file defines device-specific configuration variables and target device registrations for Netgear devices in an OpenWRT build environment. It includes device definitions such as WNR612-v2, N150R, WNR1000-v2, and WNR2000-v3, specifying hardware parameters, supported devices, and associated images.

methods.name: Device/netgear_wnr612-v2
methods.description: Defines device configuration for Netgear WNR612 v2.

methods.description: Defines device configuration for On Networks N150R.

methods.name: Device/netgear_wnr1000-v2
methods.description: Defines device configuration for Netgear WNR1000 v2.
